Digital Climate Alliance
As one of the founding members of Digital Climate Alliance 
(DCA), we contributed to its policy paper, “Promise and Peril: 
Sustainability & the Rise of Artificial Intelligence,” published 
on June 12, 2024. The paper highlights the use of technology 
and AI to advance climate and sustainability solutions across 
the economy (“handprint”) and offers strategic policy  
recommendations to maximize AI’s sustainability benefits 
while mitigating its environmental “footprint.” Intel’s smart 
agriculture example demonstrated how Nature Fresh Farms 
uses AI inferencing with the help of Intel® Xeon® processors 
to maximize its greenhouse yields.
